PLATFORM OVERVIEW
One platform to secure and connect your people and your spaces
Envoy provides facility leaders, security teams, and IT teams with unparalleled visibility into onsite occupancy and space and resource utilization, delivering the powerful insights needed to drive operational compliance and a frictionless, safe workplace experience.
Drive connectivity 
Empower teams to navigate the workplace effortlessly—from locating coworkers to finding the right space. Instantly reserve rooms, desks, or parking directly via the Envoy mobile app, calendar invites, or the interactive live map.
Enhance safety & accountability
From updates and reminders to critical alerts, keep everyone in the know leveraging conference room and designated signage displays, SMS, email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Envoy in-app notifications.
Empower decisions
Turn occupancy signals and near real-time analytics into actionable insights to operationalize safety, automate policy reporting, and drive smarter, data-driven decisions regarding space planning and growth.
Navigate compliance 
Leverage Envoy's unified platform as a part of your security and compliance infrastructure to meet stringent regulatory standards and avoid severe financial penalties, legal liabilities, and operational disruptions.

FAQ
Still have questions?
We can help.
Can I purchase Envoy products individually?
Envoy products are purchased as modules that run on top of the Envoy platform. To get started, you’ll choose a platform tier and then add the modules you need—such as visitor management, resource booking, emergency notifications, digital signage, or mailroom management. This approach keeps pricing flexible while ensuring every product works seamlessly together
How is the Envoy platform priced?
The Envoy platform is priced as a flat annual fee. It covers the foundational layer that powers every Envoy product, including administration, identity, permissions, analytics, and integrations. Module pricing is added on based on the products you choose and how you deploy them.
What’s the difference between Premium and Enterprise in the Envoy platform?
The Premium platform is designed for teams with straightforward workplace needs and includes essential administration, integrations, maps, and basic analytics.
‍
The Enterprise platform is built for complex or regulated environments and adds advanced analytics, presence signals, deeper third-party integrations, custom admin roles, and audit-ready event logs.
‍
Learn about our plans & pricing
Do I need the platform to use Envoy products?
Yes. The platform is required to use Envoy products. It provides the shared foundation that allows modules like resource booking, emergency notifications, digital signage, and mailroom management to work together securely and at scale.
Does the Envoy platform include visitor management?
Visitor management is available as a separate module that runs on the Envoy platform. This allows organizations to add visitor workflows independently while still benefiting from centralized identity, compliance records, and platform-level analytics.
What is workplace management software?
Workplace management software helps organizations coordinate people, spaces, and onsite operations. It brings together tools for visitor access, space booking, communications, analytics, and compliance in one system. Envoy’s workplace management platform connects these workflows to reduce friction and improve visibility across the workplace.
Is Envoy designed for hybrid work?
Yes. Envoy supports hybrid work by helping teams manage onsite attendance, reserve desks and rooms, communicate in real time, and understand how space is actually being used. This makes it easier to balance flexibility with operational control.
Who is the Envoy platform best suited for?
Envoy is built for organizations managing shared spaces, multiple locations, or regulated environments. It’s especially well suited for enterprise teams that need secure access control, reliable data, and the ability to scale workplace operations without adding complexity.
How does Envoy integrate with existing systems?
Envoy integrates with identity providers, access control systems, HR tools, calendars, and collaboration platforms. These integrations help automate provisioning, bookings, and permissions while keeping workplace systems in sync.
Can Envoy help with space planning and utilization?
Yes. Envoy provides visibility into how desks, rooms, and onsite spaces are used over time. Analytics help teams understand occupancy patterns, plan capacity, and make informed decisions about space and resources. Learn about workplace analytics.
